description: RAG Pipeline Enhancement - Create pluggable rankers, multiple retriever strategies, and document parsers for the knowledge subsystem. Add BM25Ranker, CrossEncoderRanker protocol at src/nexus/knowledge/rankers.py. Add DenseRetriever, SparseRetriever, HybridRetriever protocol at src/nexus/knowledge/retrievers.py. Add TextParser, MarkdownParser, CodeParser at src/nexus/knowledge/parsers.py. Enhance existing rag.py to integrate these components.
steps: Create src/nexus/knowledge/rankers.py with: (1) Ranker Protocol defining rank(query, results) -> list interface, (2) BM25Ranker class implementing the protocol using token-overlap scoring from nexus.memory.retriever.tokenize and bm25_score, (3) CrossEncoderRanker class implementing the protocol with a configurable scoring function (default: combined BM25 + token overlap as cross-encoder proxy since no new deps allowed), (4) RerankerPipeline class that chains multiple rankers sequentially

Create src/nexus/knowledge/retrievers.py with: (1) Retriever Protocol defining retrieve(query, top_k) -> list interface, (2) DenseRetriever class using embedding provider from embeddings.py for vector similarity search, (3) SparseRetriever class using BM25 from nexus.memory.retriever, (4) HybridRetriever class combining dense + sparse with configurable alpha weight, (5) RetrieverFactory function to create retrievers by name

Create src/nexus/knowledge/parsers.py with: (1) DocumentParser Protocol defining parse(content) -> list[ParsedChunk] interface, (2) ParsedChunk dataclass with content, metadata, chunk_type fields, (3) TextParser class splitting on paragraphs/sentences, (4) MarkdownParser class preserving structure (headers, code blocks, lists), (5) CodeParser class splitting on function/class boundaries using regex patterns for Python/JS/TS

Enhance src/nexus/knowledge/rag.py to accept optional ranker, retriever, and parser components via constructor parameters. Add a from_config class method that builds a RAGPipeline with specified components. Maintain full backward compatibility - existing constructor signature still works.

Update src/nexus/knowledge/__init__.py to export new classes: BM25Ranker, CrossEncoderRanker, DenseRetriever, SparseRetriever, HybridRetriever, TextParser, MarkdownParser, CodeParser, ParsedChunk, Ranker, Retriever, DocumentParser

Create tests/test_rag_pipeline_enhanced.py with comprehensive tests covering: all ranker implementations and protocol conformance, all retriever implementations with mock embedding providers, all parser implementations with sample documents of each type, RAGPipeline integration with new components, backward compatibility of existing RAGPipeline usage
acceptance_criteria: src/nexus/knowledge/rankers.py exists with Ranker Protocol, BM25Ranker, CrossEncoderRanker, and RerankerPipeline classes
src/nexus/knowledge/retrievers.py exists with Retriever Protocol, DenseRetriever, SparseRetriever, HybridRetriever, and RetrieverFactory
src/nexus/knowledge/parsers.py exists with DocumentParser Protocol, ParsedChunk dataclass, TextParser, MarkdownParser, CodeParser
src/nexus/knowledge/rag.py enhanced to optionally accept ranker, retriever, parser components while maintaining backward compatibility
src/nexus/knowledge/__init__.py exports all new public classes
tests/test_rag_pipeline_enhanced.py has tests for all new classes with at least 3 test methods per class
All files pass Python AST parsing without errors
verification: Run: python3 -c "import ast; [ast.parse(open(f'src/nexus/knowledge/{f}').read()) for f in ['rankers.py','retrievers.py','parsers.py','rag.py','__init__.py']]" to verify all knowledge module files parse cleanly
